name: Zilean
title: the Chronokeeper

Q.name: Time Bomb
Q.description: Zilean tosses a time-delayed bomb that sticks to the first unit which comes within a small area around it. After 3 seconds it detonates, dealing 75/115/165/230/300 + 0.9×AP magic damage. Placing a second bomb on a unit that already has one detonates the first bomb immediately and Stuns enemies in the blast for 1.1/1.2/1.3/1.4/1.5 seconds.
Q.summary: Tosses a bomb to target area that sticks to units that come near it (prioritizes Champions). It detonates after 3 seconds, dealing area of effect damage. If a Time Bomb is detonated early by another Time Bomb, it also stuns enemies.

W.name: Rewind
W.description: Zilean turns time, reducing his other basic Ability Cooldowns by 10 seconds.
W.summary: Zilean can prepare himself for future confrontations, reducing the cooldowns of his other basic abilities.

E.name: Time Warp
E.description: Zilean Slows an enemy champion by 40/55/70/85/99% or grants an allied champion 40/55/70/85/99% Move Speed for 2.5 seconds.
E.summary: Zilean bends time around any unit, decreasing an enemy's Move Speed or increasing an ally's Move Speed for a short time.

R.name: Chronoshift
R.description: Zilean grants a protective time rune to an allied champion for 5 seconds. If the target would die, the rune rewinds their timeline, putting them into Stasis for 3 seconds, then reviving them and restoring 600/850/1100 + 2×AP Health.
R.summary: Zilean places a protective time rune on an allied champion, teleporting the champion back in time if they take lethal damage.

Passive.name: Time In A Bottle
Passive.description: Zilean stores time as Experience and can grant it to his allies. When he has enough Experience to finish an ally's level up, he can right-click them to impart it. Zilean receives as much Experience as he gives.
Passive.summary: Zilean stores time as Experience and can grant it to his allies. When he has enough Experience to finish an ally's level up, he can right-click them to impart it. Zilean receives as much Experience as he gives.

source: Community Dragon latest (live patch) game files + client data

profile.identity: Time mage who stuns with double bombs and saves allies with Chronoshift revive. A utility and poke support/mid who scales with ability ranks and cooldowns.
strengths: Double Q bomb stun with W reset
R revives an ally (or himself) from a lethal hit
E speeds allies or slows enemies: strong kiting and engage
Long-range poke and good lane control
Passive levels up allies faster late
weaknesses: Q is slow and telegraphed: easy to dodge
Weak to dive and point-and-click engage

curve.lvl3: strong – double bomb stun with W
curve.late: strong – R and E change fights

profile.curveNote: Needs W to land the double bomb stun reliably.

Q.notes: Ground-targeted bomb (not a missile); a second bomb on the same target stuns.

W.notes: Reduces his other cooldowns: second Q.

E.notes: Slows an enemy or speeds an ally, point-and-click.

R.notes: Ally revives on death after a delay: kill them twice or wait out the buff.

Passive.notes: Stores XP and gives it to allies.

profile.windowAgainst: W down (no double bomb) or E used: engage then. Bait R before killing the target.
checks: Whether R revive should be modelled as an 'answer' type
